title: Three-Eyed Serpent Sage
description: A green reptilian humanoid with three glowing white eyes and small horns stands inside a stone archway covered in purple moss and icicles. The figure wears a dark purple hooded cloak with red lining and an eye emblem on the chest, while bright yellow flowering branches frame the scene and a human hand draws a glowing pink rune on the ground in the foreground.
prompt: A green reptilian humanoid with three glowing white eyes and horns, wearing a dark purple hooded cloak with red interior and an eye emblem, stands within an ancient stone archway covered in purple moss and icicles. Bright yellow flowering branches with blossoms frame the scene against a misty blue background. In the foreground, a human hand with a white stylus draws a glowing pink circular rune on the ground. Mystical fantasy atmosphere with dramatic lighting.
